AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app manages a high-fidelity AI Music Studio, user libraries, and content discovery. Operational Patterns: - Use 'openLibrary' and 'openHome' to switch between major app navigational sections. - Prefer 'searchForContent' over navigating manually when the user wants to find a specific track. Constraints: - Text prompts for 'strikeVibe' should be descriptive of musical atmospheres.
